summary: Write a finished deliverable's container metadata (title/artist/copyright/comment/creation_time) by stream-copy remux, from a tag set decided by the caller.

parity.note: `-c copy` — the elementary streams are re-muxed, never re-encoded, so the video bitstream is byte-identical on either transport (tests/test_deliverable_metadata_parity.py md5s the copied video stream before and after). The argv is a pure function of (paths, tags) and is pinned string-equal to the origin's own copy, so the two lanes cannot drift into different tags.

tags.description: The finished tag set. It is DECIDED by the caller: whose brand owns artist/copyright, which plan tier pays in an attribution line and what the canonical platform-neutral title is are facts of a brand profile and a tenant record, neither of which a rented box holds. The key set is CLOSED to the standard container keys — the mp4 muxer silently drops unmapped ones, and buying them with `-movflags use_metadata_tags` writes raw udta instead of ©nam/©ART, after which players and platform ingest stop seeing the title.

title.description: Canonical and platform-NEUTRAL: one file goes to YouTube, IG, TikTok and VK, so no per-network title may own the tag.

artist.description: The TENANT's brand, never the product.

copyright.description: The TENANT's brand. Our copyright in a customer's video would be a claim on their rights.

comment.description: The brand's funnel link, plus the product attribution line on the tier that pays in attribution.

creation_time.description: UTC render time. A value the file already carries wins over this one — restamping must not re-date a deliverable to its delivery.
